about: Documents' tools for agents (through Agent Link): name, what it does, its arguments as JSON Schema, its group, whether it changes the document.

card.does: Makes a dimensioned drawing of bodies in one call, and its SVG, PDF and DXF files.

bodies.means: Bodies to draw; all when left out

section.means: A straight view to draw as a full section

sectionAt.means: Distance from the middle towards the viewer

scale.means: 0.5 for 1:2, 2 for 2:1; left out, the largest standard scale (1:1, 2:1, 1:2 ...) that fits

dimensions.means: false leaves the overall sizes off

page.means: false writes the files only and adds nothing to the document

forms: a name in the session's folder
an absolute path: its folder is made
a path under the session's folder

dims.means: Feature dimensions with tolerances or ISO 286 fits
forms: { view, kind: length (a, b, along h|v, offset mm) | diameter | radius (a: a round edge), fit "H7" or plus/minus mm, label }
a and b: a point [x, y, z] or a query { body, kind, type, radius, near } (a circle's centre, an edge's middle)

holes.means: Which round holes to call out
forms: true: every round hole seen end on in a view (front, right, top ...)
the name of a view: only that view's holes

holeFits.means: A fit per hole diameter for the callouts: { "6": "H7" }

titleBlock.means: Title block fields: title, partNumber, revision, material, finish, drawnBy, date, checkedBy, company, generalTolerance

coarse.means: TechDraw's coarse (polygon) lines for the views: faster on a large assembly

links.line: A section is of a straight view that is drawn; iso is refused
Each dims view must be drawn
holeFits gives a fit per hole diameter for the callouts
Left out, coarse is true over 3000 edges when holes is not asked
holes naming a view needs the view drawn

effects: The drawing is an ordinary TechDraw page: template, title block, views, section and dimensions are all TechDraw's own, editable there
Left out, projection is TechDraw's preference, else third with inch units, else first; projectionFrom says which and why
dims adds feature dimensions with the limits written in
The extension of file is dropped, and the three files share the stem
Every call adds a NEW page, with its template, views and dimensions
The PDF and SVG come from TechDraw only with FreeCAD's window up
Headless, the PDF and SVG come from Workshop's sheet writer; filesFrom says which and why
TechDraw works out the lines of a view on another thread, so the call waits for them
It waits 30 s a view, and longer for a view of many edges (page.viewLimit, 240 s at most)
The overall sizes go on each view when it is drawn, also when it is drawn late
coarse: lines says which and why
A changing tool cannot run as a job
Vertex and edge numbers of a view change when the model does, so dimensions are made here, not carried over
The answer of a changing call can also hold health from the shared check
The files are the page's exports where TechDraw can write them (filesFrom: techdrawPage)
The other files come from Workshop's sheet writer (filesFrom: sheetWriter)
The sheet writer also draws the hole callouts and overall sizes that the page has as TechDraw dimensions
Ask the person for their titleBlock, and never make a name up
Hole callouts are grouped by size, for example "4× ⌀3.4"
With holes true, a hole is called out in a view that sees it end on
generalTolerance starts as ISO 2768-m
The titleBlock fields are filled into TechDraw's title block and the files' own

filesFrom.means: per file kind: techdrawPage, or {from: sheetWriter, why: needsWindow | wroteNothing | templateLeftOut | noViewGeometry | noPage | failed, error}

paper.means: The paper chosen: A4 or A3

projection.means: first or third: the projection of the views

projectionFrom.means: Which source set the projection, and why

fill.means: Share of the free sheet area the views cover, 0 to 1

views.means: Per view: view, at, size, scale

dimensions.means: [{ view, axis, mm }] overall sizes, then each asked one { view, kind, value, label }

holes.means: Per hole group: view, diameter, count, label, from, features, calloutOff

holeTable.means: { at: [x, y] on the sheet, rows } for holes no view sees end on

calloutsOff.means: [{ view, label, why: noCircle, diameter }] callouts left off the sheet

titleBlock.means: The title block's fields as drawn: title, scale, projection, generalTolerance, material, sheet, date

techdrawPage.means: The label of the TechDraw page made

page.means: The state of the TechDraw page: views, notOnPage [{ view, type, value, item, why }], viewsInExport and settled among others

pageNote.means: why there is no page: {reason: notAsked | notMade, error}

timing.means: { sheet, page, export, settle, turns, turnMs, total, sheetSplit, sheetLines } of where the time went

step.means: The undo step number of this call

lines.means: { coarse, from, edges, viewLimit, sheetLines } the line detail used and why

page.notOnPage.means: [{ view, type, value, item?, why: timeLimit | refused | failed | noVertices | onePoint | measuredOther | viewNotOnPage | noGeometry | noReference, error?, measured?, wanted?, tried? }] dimensions and callouts TechDraw did not place

page.sectionNote.means: { reason, error }: the section view is not on the page; the files have it

page.holeTableNote.means: { reason, error }: the hole table is not on the page; the files have it

holes.calloutOff.means: { reason: noCircle, diameter, view }: no circle of that diameter is drawn where the hole is in that view

page.dimensions.placedOn.means: nearestCircle: a callout was put on the view's circle of its size nearest the hole

page.dimensions.wanted.means: The value the dimension was drawn for, when TechDraw measured another

refusalNotes: Refused: a view that is not one of the seven
Refused: a section of iso or of a view not drawn
Refused: a scale of 0 or under
Refused: dims with a view not drawn, or a kind other than length, diameter, radius
Refused: holes naming a view not drawn
hints: When you redraw, object_delete the old page first
Every key of page and timing, and the behaviour in full: guide_read { topic: "drawing", section: "drawing_make in full" }
The guide section holds the layout, the exports, the waits for TechDraw, and where hole callouts go
A callout with placedOn nearestCircle: check it is the hole meant.
A view with why timeLimit is placed when it is drawn before the export (page.lateExtents), else left off.
With why noViewGeometry the page itself is fine: File > Export it in FreeCAD's window.

steps.means: Steps in the order the parts go together: [{ title, add: [bodies], note }]

explode.means: How far the new parts are moved off in each picture
explode.default: 0.6 of the largest size, at least 10

direction.means: up lifts the new parts over their places; out moves them away from the middle

page.means: A TechDraw page of the Assembly's Exploded View (in an Assembly), else of the last step's picture

links.line: In each step the parts already in place stay and the new ones are moved off by explode mm

effects: Each step is an isometric picture (SVG)
A trail shows where each part goes, and a balloon gives its item number
It writes the steps and <name>_assembly.md with a bill of materials to the folder of the session
In the bill, bodies of the same shape are one item
Each item has the material and mass where part_spec or material_set recorded one
Each item has how it is made, from its setup, and Fasteners Workbench hardware by its own name
Where every body is in one FreeCAD Assembly, this also CHANGES THE DOCUMENT
The moves become the Assembly's own Exploded View, editable there
The parts of step k move k − 1 explode lengths up, or out from step 2 on
Unless page: false, it also adds an ordinary TechDraw page of it
The page has a balloon per item and the bill of materials
Each call adds another Exploded View and page
Outside an Assembly, route says that the steps use Workshop's own exploded shapes
Outside an Assembly, a blank TechDraw page shows the picture of the last step as a symbol, unless page: false
pageShows says which step
So the window shows the result
With page: false, nothing is added, and the call is still one (empty) undo step
So a history_undo straight after it takes back nothing in the document
Each part is lifted over where it is in the document
The answer of a changing call can also hold health from the shared check
With no FreeCAD Assembly the steps are drawn from Workshop's own exploded shapes
Parts listed in apart are lifted over their place in the document

manual.means: Path of the assembly manual, a .md file

steps.means: Per step: step, title, adds [{ item, part, qty }], svg

bom.means: Per item: item, part, bodies, size, material, massG, madeBy

explode.means: How far each part is moved, from the explode input or worked out

notInAnyStep.means: Bodies that are in no step

route.means: FreeCAD Assembly Exploded View, or Workshop's own exploded shapes

routeNote.means: why the own shapes were used: {reason: noAssembly | notMade, error}

explodedView.means: The label of the Exploded View made in the FreeCAD Assembly

assembly.means: The label of the Assembly that holds the Exploded View

moves.means: How many parts the Exploded View moves

page.means: The label of the TechDraw page made from the steps

pageNote.means: the TechDraw page was not made: {reason, error}

apart.means: the parts lying apart from the parts before them, not where they go

refusalNotes: A body goes in once; a second time is refused, naming its step
hints: Delete the old Exploded Views and pages (object_delete) before you make it again
Put the parts where they go first
Put the parts listed in apart over their place in the document first, with object_set Placement
A lid printed top down turns over about X
Then draw again; view_render shows where the parts are
Put the parts in an Assembly for FreeCAD's own Exploded View, editable there

card.does: Makes patent-style figures FIG. 1 ... of bodies, one per view.

bodies.means: Bodies to draw; all when left out

views.means: Views to draw, one figure each

name.means: The stem of the files and the label of the pages

page.means: Each figure as a TechDraw page too (true by default)

effects: The figures are black line art on A4 portrait within the USPTO's margins, with no hidden lines or shading
Each part gets its reference numeral (10, 20, 30 ...), 3.5 mm high
A lead line goes to a face of the part that the viewer sees
The numerals of the answer go by label
A part hidden behind others in a view gets no numeral there (notSeenIn)
It writes an SVG and a PDF per figure to the folder of the session
It also writes a list of the numerals there
Unless page: false, each figure is also added to the document as an ordinary TechDraw page in that style
The page has a blank template and visible lines only
The numerals are TechDraw balloons without a bubble, editable in TechDraw
This changes the document, one page a figure
Every call adds new pages
The files are the page's own exports where TechDraw can write them (FreeCAD's window up)
Else the files come from Workshop's sheet writer (filesFrom says which and why)
page: false writes the files only and changes nothing
After the export of each page, nothing of it stays marked as changed
TechDraw's export marks the template; the description of drawing_make says how this works
It takes seconds per figure (exact hidden-line removal), longer for a detailed assembly
patent_draft uses the numerals and figures of the last call in this session
The answer of a changing call can also hold health from the shared check
numerals names a body by its label or its object's name, as bodies takes it
Each numeral is a whole number over 0, and each its own
The settled key is in a figure's row only when a mark stayed (left)
Or when a mark can still come after the call (late), or nothing could be watched

figures.means: Per figure: fig, view, page | pageNote, svg, pdf, filesFrom, settled, timing

list.means: Path of the numerals list, a .md file

notSeenIn.means: { body: [views] } parts that have no numeral in those views

timing.means: Whole call: figures, turns, turnMs, total

figures.timing.means: In each figure's row: sheet, page, export { wait, scene, svg, check, pdf }, settle, turns, turnMs, total

paper.means: The sheet size of the figures: A4

figures.settled.means: In a figure's row: cleared, waited, exportMs, turns, turnMs, seen, late, left

figures.timing.page.means: The TechDraw page, with the lines of its view waited for

figures.timing.export.means: TechDraw's SVG and PDF and what they need first

figures.timing.turns.means: The turns of FreeCAD's event loop run for the figure

refusalNotes: Refused: a view that is not one of the views
Refused: a numeral that is not a whole number over 0
Refused: a numeral used twice, or for a body not drawn

card.does: Writes a Markdown draft of a patent description and a claims skeleton to the folder of the session.

title.means: What the invention is, in a few words

bodies.means: Bodies to draw; left out, those of the last patent_figures, else all

effects: It describes the bodies from the model: their sizes, and which adjoin which
It uses the numerals and figures of the last patent_figures in this session
Without a patent_figures run first, the draft has no figures or numerals
It leaves in brackets what only the inventor and counsel can say
It is a starting point for the review of a patent attorney, and the file says so
It is never filed or sent anywhere
Changes nothing in the document
The draft is for an attorney's review, written to the output folder only; nothing is filed or sent.
Never present the draft as ready to file

draft.means: Path of the draft, a .md file

numerals.means: { label: n } the reference numerals used

figures.means: How many figures the draft refers to

card.does: Packs bodies to share as one zip in the folder of the session.

bodies.means: Bodies to pack; all when left out

license.means: The license decides what others may do with the parts

author.means: The name they want shown; a handle will do; required for all but CC0

credits.means: For remixed parts: [{ title, author, url, license, changes }]

formats.means: Formats in the zip; both when left out

provider.means: auto (default): ScanRuler's pack when installed, else Documents' own; documents forces Documents' own

links.line: author is required for all licenses but CC0
credits is refused when a credited part's license does not allow the one chosen (no-derivatives, non-commercial, share-alike)
provider decides who makes the pack

effects: The zip holds each body as STEP and STL, and a README with their sizes, material and mass
The README also holds the print settings from their print setup (magnet pauses too)
The zip also holds a LICENSE and credits
The STEP header holds the name of the file and the author given: no path, user name or organisation
personal names any file that still has one
provider auto uses ScanRuler-FreeCAD's pack when that add-on is installed (through Agent Link's library_pack service), else Documents' own
by says which made the pack
serviceNote says when the service failed and Documents' own made it instead
Meshing a detailed body for the STL takes a while
Changes nothing in the document
Ask the person which license: it decides what others may do with the parts

files.means: [names] of the files in the zip

parts.means: [{ files, size: [x, y, z] }] per part

warnings.means: [lines] credit warnings from the license check

unsound.means: bodies body_check says are not sound: {bodies, from}

personal.means: files with a path or user name still in their first lines: {files, in: firstLines}

serviceNote.means: When the service failed and Documents' own made the pack

refusalNotes: Refused: no licence, or one not listed
Refused: no author where the licence needs one
Refused: credits that are not a list of objects
Refused: formats other than step and stl
Refused: no body in the document
hints: Fix unsound bodies and clear personal paths or user names before sharing.
